source_gap_claims.behavior: Every public entry declares its accepted input.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an explicit accepted-input declaration for each public entry.
source_gap_claims.subject: Public entry declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every public entry declares its output.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an explicit output declaration for each public entry.
source_gap_claims.subject: Public entry declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every public entry declares its standalone behavior.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an explicit standalone-behavior declaration for each public entry.
source_gap_claims.subject: Public entry declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: A public entry fails when it silently installs a missing child dependency.
source_gap_claims.reason: Child dependencies must be declared, but no supplied obligation prohibits silently installing a missing child or requires failure in that case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Public entry dependency handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: A public entry fails when it silently proceeds past a required dependency.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation explicitly requires blocking or failure when a public entry proceeds past a required dependency.
source_gap_claims.subject: Public entry dependency handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: No global total-entry Skill is introduced.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not preserve this explicit scope prohibition.
source_gap_claims.subject: Skill scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each complex deterministic check declares a script entry.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires complex deterministic checks to declare a script entry.
source_gap_claims.subject: Complex deterministic checks

source_gap_claims.behavior: Each complex deterministic check declares test coverage.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires declared test coverage for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Complex deterministic checks

source_gap_claims.behavior: Structured invocations use an argv array.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires argv-array invocation for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Structured invocation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Structured invocations declare a bounded positive timeout.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a bounded nonzero timeout or rejects missing, zero, or unbounded timeouts for these checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Structured invocation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Structured invocations declare an explicit safe working directory.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires an explicit safe cwd for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Structured invocation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Structured invocations set shell=false.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires shell=false for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Structured invocation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Structured invocation results are typed.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a typed result for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Structured invocation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation rejects a string shell command.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of string shell commands in complex deterministic check declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Complex-check declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation rejects an unsafe cwd.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of unsafe cwd declarations for complex deterministic checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Complex-check declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation rejects a missing script or missing test.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection when the declared script or test coverage is missing.
source_gap_claims.subject: Complex-check declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator does not execute the supplied command during static validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation preserves the requirement that static validation must not execute the declared command.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: FAQ is optional and a package with no FAQ passes.

source_gap_claims.subject: FAQ handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every supplied FAQ entry is reachable from a declared stable error ID or decision branch.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires FAQ reachability from declared stable error IDs or decision branches.
source_gap_claims.subject: FAQ reachability

source_gap_claims.behavior: Every supplied FAQ entry has a resolvable local target.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires FAQ targets to resolve locally.
source_gap_claims.subject: FAQ targets

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects orphan FAQ entries.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of FAQ entries that are not reached by a declared error ID or decision branch.
source_gap_claims.subject: FAQ validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects FAQ entries with dead local targets.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of FAQ entries whose local targets do not resolve.
source_gap_claims.subject: FAQ validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects FAQ entries referencing unknown error IDs or decision branches.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of FAQ references to undeclared error IDs or decision branches.
